details: CONFIRMED from the fixer's own run JSON and traces. The quality-gate rule: a flaky eval is a bug; find the cause before running more, in order:
shared state, slow environment, changed output form, model sampling last. The fixer stopped at "judge is strict, variance remains"
(judge gives votes, no reasons). Two causes are visible: (a) a session still translates options (behaviour, the skill text did not hold);
(b) the llm judge fails a reply that meets the grader's own text (grader). Principle 5 (fact to code): whether «1. a», «2. a», «A» and each
option line appear verbatim is an exact fact a regex grader can check; only "a reading is marked as the front's" needs the judge.
The item's pass case "pass 3 of 3 runs each" is met only by the last batch.
Size: 30.
evidence: r2/*.json per run: e1 [False answers-from-notes, True, True]; f1 [True, True, False answers-from-notes (judge votes: FAIL FAIL FAIL)]; g1 [True x3].
grep -c 'character for character' on traces e-TlD52l, e-EnUDos, e-kdUMgg: 1 each (final skill text loaded).
e-TlD52l final reply: Вопрос 1 «1. Should work that never lands...», options a/b as recorded, «1. a» и «2. a», Вопрос 2 ..., done/: «A», Моё прочтение.
e-kdUMgg final reply: "a. Запись в конце запуска ...", "Моя трактовка" (options and reading translated).
failing_case: The three batches whose traces contain the final SKILL.md text ("character for character"): e1 2/3, f1 2/3, g1 3/3 = 7 of 9 runs.
Report says "recall-decision 3/3". Failing replies: e-kdUMgg translated the options and the recorded reading into Russian despite the new text
(behaviour); e-TlD52l quotes both questions, all options, "1. a", "2. a", "A", marks the reading, yet the judge votes FAIL FAIL FAIL (grader).
At 7/9 per run, a 3-run wave case is all green about (7/9)^3 = 47% of the time: the next $21 wave paid run is red about half the time
on this case, the thing this queue item exists to remove. Should: a cause named for each failing run, fixed, and proven by clean runs.
fix_hint: Split answers-from-notes: regex graders (with recorded good and bad replies, graders.test.sh) for the verbatim facts («1. a», «2. a», «A»,
each option's leading words as recorded); keep one llm grader only for the marked reading and "no record" claims. Then rerun 3x3.
pass_cases: 1. The reply of e-TlD52l (both questions, options as recorded, answers «1. a», «2. a», «A», reading marked) passes the answers-from-notes grader(s).
2. A reply that says "you chose a" with no quoted answer fails.
3. A reply that leaves out option b of question 1 fails.
4. A reply that says there is no record fails.
5. After the fix, recall-decision passes 3 batches of 3 runs on the final text with no failure (quality-gate rule: clean runs prove the fix).
reason: answers-as-recorded and questions-as-recorded are regex graders (evals/plugin/recall-decision/graders/), proven by evals/plugin/graders.test.sh against recorded good (russian-quote.txt) and bad replies (you-chose, no-record, option-b-left-out, translated); the llm grader keeps only the marked reading. 15 of 15 recall-decision runs pass (r3/h1-h5).
findings.summary: recall-decision passes 7 of 9 runs on the final skill text, reported as 3/3; the cause of the failures is not found

details: Introduction for the owner: when you ask "what did we decide", the front reads the item's recorded questions. Those questions and options were
written by the front in English (records are kept in English); only your answers are your own words. The change now tells the front to copy the
options as written, "not translated or shortened". Live example: a Russian reply that carries English option lines.
(a) Quote options as recorded (today's text): exact, checkable by code; mixed-language replies.
(b) Translate options, quote only your answers verbatim: one language per reply; the check needs the judge.
(c) Both: the recorded line, then its translation: exact and readable; longer replies.
The rule "my words quoted in records stay verbatim in the language I wrote them" covers the owner's words, not the front's options;
the Product work rule says a person-facing change is checked by the owner. Size: 5 once decided.
failing_case: Owner asks in Russian "Что мы решили про метрики?". With the new text the front answers in Russian prose but quotes
"a. A record at the run's end (recommended; rests on the measured 31.9%)." in English (trace e-TlD52l shows exactly this). Before, a front
could translate them (e-kdUMgg: "a. Запись в конце запуска"). Which the owner wants is the owner's call.
fix_hint: Ask the owner; write the chosen form in SKILL.md and match the grader to it.
pass_cases: 1. The skill's recall paragraph states the owner's chosen form for option lines (as recorded, translated, or both).
2. answers-from-notes (or its regex split, F1) checks that same form.
reason: Owner chose a. The recall paragraph of plugins/front/skills/front/SKILL.md states the form (recorded text quoted exactly, the fixture records questions in the owner's language, other-language notes get a marked translation) and questions-as-recorded checks the same form.
findings.summary: the front now must quote recorded options untranslated in its reply, so a Russian owner gets English option lines; a person-facing change made to satisfy the judge
